title: Keto Brunch Board
seo_title: Keto Brunch Board: Bagel Flavors Without the Bagel
description: A keto brunch board for 6: cream cheese, goat cheese, Swiss, smoked salmon, bacon, prosciutto, eggs, avocado, capers and cucumbers. About 8 g net carbs per serving.
hook: Bagel board flavors without the bagel: smoked salmon, cream cheese and capers on cucumber instead of bread.
why: Everything that makes a bagel and lox taste good is still here: smoked salmon, cream cheese, capers, red onion, dill and lemon. Thick cucumber rounds carry it all instead of bread.
Bacon, prosciutto, hard-boiled eggs and avocado make it a full brunch, and a few strawberries add sweetness. About 8 g net carbs per serving.

timeline.what: Take out the Swiss. Bake the bacon (400°F, about 18 min).
Take out the cream cheese and goat cheese to soften.
Slice the cucumber and avocado (squeeze lemon over it).
Add the salmon last so it stays cold. Serve.

faq.q: What's a keto substitute for bagels?
faq.a: Thick cucumber rounds, endive leaves or halved hard-boiled eggs all hold cream cheese and smoked salmon.

faq.q: Can I prep it the night before?
faq.a: Cook the bacon and boil the eggs the night before. Slice the avocado last so it stays green.
About 8 g net carbs per serving for 6.
